turns.text: Hello, come in. How have you been since last time?
Some days are better than others, and I try to remind myself of that when things get heavy.
Tell me more about that.
The vet says Biscuit is in pain a lot of the time and we need to think about what is kind.
What happened next?
It is strange to sit here and say all of this out loud, but it does help a little. That is how it was.
And how was that for you?
The journey here took a while, but at least I had time to gather my thoughts.
Tell me more about that.
Some mornings it hits me that she is gone and I can hardly breathe.
Mm-hm. Go on.
I am not sure where to begin, there are so many things going round in my head at the moment. I think so, yes.
Tell me more about that.
The train was late again this morning, so I almost did not make it on time today.
How did that feel for you?
Now I volunteer both Tuesday and Thursday at the food bank.
How did that feel for you?
I wrote a few notes before coming here, but now I cannot remember half of what I wanted to say. It is not easy to talk about.
Take your time.
The hospital sent a letter saying they will hold a review meeting on the twentieth of March.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
I had a long day yesterday and I was so tired in the evening that I just sat in front of the television. I think so, yes.
We are nearly out of time. Is there anything you want to add?
No, I think that is everything. Thank you.
